hypothesis: Instruction count follows the number of sift-up comparisons and swaps, with separate overhead for list growth and initial insertion.

pcvs.name: sift_depth
pcvs.rationale: Computes the insertion depth for the exercised heap sizes 0 through 11. Decreasing incoming priorities cause each insertion to traverse this entire depth.

pcvs.name: list_growth
pcvs.rationale: Identifies subsequent list capacity growth points for this initially empty heap under standard CPython allocation.

pcvs.name: empty_heap
pcvs.rationale: Captures initial allocation and the distinct first-insertion path.
